description: This file defines template classes for managing web transfer operations, including client and server transfer types, within a Web namespace. It includes classes for handling transfer states, link management, request/response processing, hash calculation, and signature validation, primarily for HTTP-based file transfer over websockets.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A template class that manages a singleton element of type ELEMENT, providing access via the Element() method.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: Template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including state management, request handling, hash calculation, and transfer control for upload/download operations.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: Template class managing server-side web transfer operations, handling incoming requests, file storage, hash validation, and response generation.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information about a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a destination file.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Prepares the transfer with a remote URL (virtual, to be implemented).

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Callback invoked when info collection completes.
